svg.text: Dell PowerEdge R7725 — L3-as-NUMA (24 NUMA Nodes, 1 per CCD)
AMD EPYC 9825 · 12 CCDs/socket · 12c + 12HT per node · ~31 GB per node
All same-socket CCDs are equidistant (distance 11). No quadrant grouping visible.
L3-as-NUMA provides per-CCD cache isolation but no finer I/O topology than NPS1.
